description: This Java source file defines the RenderContentTransform class, which implements a Freemarker TemplateTransformModel. It provides functionality for rendering content as text within a Freemarker template, including optional editing controls.

classes.name: RenderContentTransform
classes.description: Implements a Freemarker TemplateTransformModel to render content as text, supporting in-template editing features.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns a custom Writer that renders content as text, possibly with editing controls, when invoked during Freemarker template processing.

methods.name: renderSubContent
methods.description: Performs the actual content rendering, handling XML escaping and editing controls.

methods.name: openEditWrap
methods.description: Wraps the rendered content in a div with editing style for inline editing.

methods.name: closeEditWrap
methods.description: Closes the editing wrapper by adding an 'Edit' link associated with the content.

methods.name: getEditStyle
methods.description: Determines the CSS class for editing style, with fallback to default properties.
